title: 薄荷茶和暖毛衣  (Tea and a Warm Cardigan)

segments.t: In the warm café corner, Mei brings over a pot of herbal tea and a neatly folded cream cardigan for Teacher Song, while Chen locks the mystery suitcase safely away. Listen first.
宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
宋老师，您穿着很合适。
你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
我把那个蓝色行李箱锁在储藏室里了。
谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
Now let's walk through each line slowly.
宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
'Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.' Look at
蜂蜜
built from 'bee' plus 'nectar-sweet', painting the picture of honey straight from the hive.
谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
'Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!' Notice the lively expression
吓了一跳
literally 'startled one jump', how Mandarin describes getting a sudden fright.
您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
'Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.' Repeating the action word in
试试
makes 'try it on' sound gentle and low-pressure, never pushy.
真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
'Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!' Pairing 'both... and...' is effortless in Chinese: repeat the same small linking word before 'pretty' and before 'warm'.
宋老师，您穿着很合适。
'Teacher Song, it fits you very well.' Whether clothes fit your size or a time suits your schedule, Mandarin uses
合适
built from 'match' and 'suit'.
我把那个蓝色行李箱锁在储藏室里了。
'I locked that blue suitcase safely inside the storeroom.' Chen uses the 'take-hold' sentence pattern to move the blue suitcase before the action 'lock', spotlighting where the bag ended up.
箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
'The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.' Mei sounds confident thanks to
肯定
a crisp everyday word for 'definitely' or 'for sure'.
您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
'Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.' Keep
随时
in your pocket: literally 'follow-time', it means 'at any time' whenever you offer help. Now let's hear the whole conversation again from start to finish.
宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
宋老师，您穿着很合适。
你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
我把那个蓝色行李箱锁在储藏室里了。
谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
Hot mint tea and a borrowed cardigan turned an upsetting afternoon into a gentle evening. One final scene remains in Episode 1, and a surprise is waiting outside the gate. See you next time.
明天见！
